cards.name: Blue-Eyes Alternative White Dragon, the Guided Phantom Beast
cards.desc: If this card is in your hand: You can banish 1 "Blue-Eyes White Dragon" from your hand or Deck; Special Summon this card, then you can place 1 "Endless Darkness" from your hand, Deck, or GY, face-up in your Field Zone. If you have a banished "Blue-Eyes" monster: You can target 1 card your opponent controls; banish it, also this card cannot attack this turn. You can only use each effect of "Blue-Eyes Alternative White Dragon, the Guided Phantom Beast" once per turn.

cards.name: Assault Slash Wyvern
cards.desc: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can send to the GY, or banish, 1 "Blue-Eyes" monster from your Deck. If you have a banished "Blue-Eyes" monster: You can Tribute this card; Special Summon 1 "Blue-Eyes White Dragon" or 1 monster that mentions "Endless Darkness", except "Assault Slash Wyvern", from your Deck or GY. You can only use each effect of "Assault Slash Wyvern" once per turn.

cards.name: Dimensional Ascension
cards.desc: Special Summon 1 monster that mentions "Endless Darkness" from your GY or banishment, or if you activated this card the turn your opponent activated a card or effect, you can Special Summon from your Deck instead. At the start of the Battle Phase: You can banish this card from your GY; Special Summon 1 of your banished "Blue-Eyes White Dragon", but banish it at the end of the Battle Phase. You can only use each effect of "Dimensional Ascension" once per turn.
